blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.description: While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Can't See: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.description: While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Can't Harm the Charmer: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects.
Social Advantage: The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

deafened.name: Deafened
deafened.description: While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effect.
effects: Can't Hear: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.description: While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experience the following effects. This condition is cumulative (levels 1-6).
effects: Exhaustion Levels: Cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 level. You die if your Exhaustion level reaches 6.
D20 Tests Affected: When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level.
Speed Reduced: Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level.
Removing Exhaustion: Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 level of Exhaustion. When level reaches 0, the condition ends.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Ability Checks and Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.
Can't Approach: You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.description: While you have the Grappled condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
Movable: The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs 1 extra foot unless you are Tiny or 2+ sizes smaller.
Escape: You can make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the grapple DC (8 + STR mod + PB) at the end of your turn to escape.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.description: While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Inactive: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
No Concentration: Your Concentration is broken immediately.
Speechless: You can't speak.
Surprised: If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.description: While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Surprise: If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll.
Concealed: You aren't affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen unless the creator can see you. Equipment is also concealed.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage (unless the target can see you).

paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
paralyzed.description: While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Incapacitated: You have the Incapacitated condition.
Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Automatic Critical Hits: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.description: While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Turned to Stone: You are transformed along with nonmagical gear into solid inanimate substance. Weight increases 10x, aging ceases.
Incapacitated: You have the Incapacitated condition.
Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Damage Resistance: You have Resistance to all damage.
Poison Immunity: You are immune to Poison and the Poisoned condition.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effect.
effects: Ability Checks and Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Restricted Movement: Your only movement options are to crawl or spend half your Speed (round down) to right yourself.
Attacks Affected: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls.
Incoming Attacks: An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.description: While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.
Saving Throws Affected: You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Incapacitated: You have the Incapacitated condition.
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.description: While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects.
effects: Inert: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone.
Speed 0: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attacks Affected: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Saving Throws Affected: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Automatic Critical Hits: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
Unaware: You are unaware of your surroundings.
